content.value: Four components are components are inspected and three events A, B, C are defined (19) as follows:
A = All four components are found to be in proper working order.
B = At least two components are found to be defective.
C = Exactly one components is found defective.
(i) How many elementary events exist in the sample space?
(ii) Define above events by the element of set.
(iii) Interpret the following events: B U C, B ∩ C, A U C.
